mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies out at Badger Prairie County Park with a Waxing Gibbous moon overhead. If you look to the sky at 5:47 PM, you can catch the space station as it rises over Cross Plains and heads toward Madison near Home Depot for a 4 minute flight.

The city has announced upcoming construction for North Shuman, North Marietta, Plympton, Miller, West Harriet, Richard Street, and Westlawn Circle. These projects, scheduled for 2027 and 2028, will replace 1950s-era underground utilities and reconstruct the roadways. Public information meetings are expected in the fall of 2026 to collect resident input.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness or stop by ART House 360 for their Thursday night entertainment. Tomorrow, head out for live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus in Verona this evening.

Looking at the most recent report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which led to the arrest of a 48-year-old Verona man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Double Strawberry. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by later to enjoy a scoop before they close at 10:00 PM.
